exchange_txn_nse.note: UNVERIFIED for 2010-2020 history. 0.00325% (Rs 3.25/lakh) is the first-slab rate implied by the 2023 rollback to pre-hike levels; NSE was slab-wise by member monthly volume (Rs 3.25 down to Rs 3.00/lakh), retail brokers generally passed on the first slab. IPFT contribution Rs 0.01/cr (negligible). Same rate delivery and intraday, both sides.
Rs 3.45/lakh first slab (6% hike via NSE/FA/46730 dated 18-Dec-2020, effective date per nse_ipft_2021_pr). Slab-wise; top slab Rs 3.20/lakh.
Txn charge Rs 3.25/lakh (first slab) + NSE IPFT Rs 10/cr (0.0001%) = 0.00335% total exchange outflow per side. Brokers showed txn 0.00325% with IPFT separately.
Txn charge 0.00322% (approx. 1% cut, see bs_apr2024) + IPFT 0.0001% = 0.00332%. NSE circular not text-verified; rate from broker bulletin.

Flat (non-slab) txn charge Rs 297/cr (0.00297%) per SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MRD/TPD-1/P/CIR/2024/92 (uniform MII charges) + IPFT Rs 10/cr = Rs 307/cr per side (figures stated in NSE/FA/73061 'existing outflow').

Txn charge Rs 306.99/cr + IPFT Rs 0.01/cr = Rs 307/cr per side; no change in total outflow, IPFT folded into txn charge. Matches zerodha_charges_live 0.00307%. rate field = txn + IPFT throughout this table.

sebi_turnover_fee.note: UNVERIFIED. Pre-28-09-2015 cash-segment fee not found in a primary source; Rs 10/cr used as representative. A Jan-2017 SEBI board release described the then-existing fee as Rs 20/cr, conflicting with the 2015 regulation text (Rs 10/cr).
0.0001% of turnover per Schedule V Table 1 inserted w.e.f. 28-09-2015. See conflict note above (board release said Rs 20 -> Rs 15).
COVID relief: brokers pay 50% of the Rs 10/cr fee. Some brokers (e.g. Zerodha) collected Rs 5/cr from clients; pass-through varied by broker.
Back to Rs 10/cr after relief period ended (nse_fa_44514); live broker page confirms Rs 10/cr on 2026-10-19.

stamp_duty.note: pre-2020-07-01 state-specific; use representative value and flag. Representative = Maharashtra delivery 0.01%; intraday 0.002% (low end of 'most states Rs 200-300/cr'). Before 2020-07-01 duty was generally levied on BOTH buy and sell (zerodha_stamp_2020); a simulator wanting fidelity should apply these rates to the sell side too. Some states had per-contract-note caps. UNVERIFIED as to exact per-state rates and dates.

Indian Stamp Act 1899 as amended by Finance Act 2019; uniform national rate, buyer only, collected by exchanges/depositories. Effective date deferred twice (09-Jan-2020, 01-Apr-2020) to 01-Jul-2020 (upstox_stamp_2020). Delivery Rs 1500/cr, intraday Rs 300/cr.

gst.note: Service tax (10% + 3% education cesses). Whether brokers levied it on the SEBI fee is UNVERIFIED.

GST 18% on (brokerage + exchange txn + SEBI fee) per broker contract-note practice; not on STT or stamp duty. GST rollout date per gst_rollout. GST 2.0 rate rationalisation (22-Sep-2025) reportedly left broking at 18% (secondary sources only).

components.dp_charge_note: Depository (DP) charges apply per scrip per day on delivery SELLS only (debit from demat), are flat rupee amounts (not percentage), and are broker- and depository-specific (e.g. Zerodha 2026: Rs 15.34 incl. GST = Rs 3.5 CDSL + Rs 9.5 broker + GST). Historical DP charge levels are not modelled; simulator should expose a user-configurable flat fee per sell order.
components.brokerage_note: brokerage is broker-specific; simulator uses a user-configurable default

settlement.note: T+2 rolling settlement for all equities.

Phased migration: from 2022-02-25 the bottom-100 stocks by market cap moved to T+1, more batches monthly; a given stock may already be T+1 in this window. Per-stock switch dates are in exchange circulars (not captured here).
Final batch (largest stocks incl. Nifty 50) moved; all equities T+1. Optional same-day T+0 (beta, limited stocks/brokers) introduced 2024-03-28 - ignored by simulator.

market_rules.price_bands_note: Non-F&O stocks: fixed daily price bands of 2%, 5%, 10% or 20% (exchange-assigned per stock, reviewed periodically; some series like BE/T2T have tighter bands). Stocks with F&O contracts: no fixed circuit, dynamic price bands (operating range, initially 10%, flexed in 5% steps when hit; Aug/Nov-2024 NSE circulars tightened flex conditions: trigger at 9.90%, min 50 trades/10 UCCs/3 members). The per-stock band history is NOT in this file; the full bhavcopy does not carry band; NSE publishes daily band-change files. SEBI reportedly considering uniform dynamic bands for all F&O securities (Apr-2026, UNVERIFIED).

circuit_breaker_index_levels.index: Nifty 50 or Sensex, whichever breached first
circuit_breaker_index_levels.reference_level: Fixed absolute points for each calendar quarter from previous quarter-end close, rounded to nearest 25 points

halts.10: before 13:00: 1 h; 13:00-14:30: 30 min; at/after 14:30: no halt
halts.15: before 13:00: 2 h; 13:00-14:00: 1 h; at/after 14:00: rest of day

circuit_breaker_index_levels.index: Nifty 50 or Sensex, whichever breached first
circuit_breaker_index_levels.reference_level: Previous trading day's closing index value, rounded to nearest tick (recomputed daily)

halts.10: before 13:00: 45 min halt + 15 min pre-open; 13:00-14:30: 15 min + 15 min pre-open; at/after 14:30: no halt
halts.15: before 13:00: 1 h 45 min + 15 min pre-open; 13:00-14:00: 45 min + 15 min pre-open; at/after 14:00: market closed for day

market_rules.tick_size_note: NSE equity tick was Rs 0.05 for all stocks through 2024-06-09. From 2024-06-10 stocks closing below Rs 250 on the last trading day of the prior month trade in Rs 0.01 ticks (EQ/BE/BZ etc. series, excl. ETFs), reviewed monthly; stocks >= Rs 250 keep Rs 0.05 (zerodha_tick_2024). Any 2025-2026 tick-size slab revisions: UNVERIFIED (none found).
market_rules.closing_price_note: Closing price = VWAP of last 30 minutes of continuous trading through 2026-07-31. From 2026-08-03 a Closing Auction Session (15:15-15:35) sets the close for stocks with derivatives; other stocks continue with VWAP (SEBI circular 16-Jan-2026; NSE go-live per secondary sources, see nse_cas_2026). Treat as UNVERIFIED until the NSE circular text is checked.
